verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a per-merchant deposit frequency that can be changed for Active merchants through the Update merchant endpoint, so per-seller payout scheduling is a first-party capability. The evidence does not list which frequencies are supported, and it never mentions instant payouts. missing for 10: documented daily/weekly/monthly/manual frequency options, instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, payouts run on the schedule each seller needs — daily, weekly, monthly, or manual, plus instant payouts to cards or real-time rails where supported, configurable per seller

citations.quote: For **Active** merchants, the deposit frequency can be updated by setting the new deposit frequency on the [Update merchant] endpoint.
